implementation_targets.github: Cloudflare Workers + D1 or Neon + HTML/JS dashboard
implementation_targets.floot: Floot React + Floot PostgreSQL + Floot authentication + scheduled jobs

owner_bootstrap.github: SUPERADMIN_EMAILS allowlist, checked server-side from authenticated email
owner_bootstrap.floot: Floot owner-controlled admin role; require explicit owner verification before granting superadmin

operations.user_search: Staff can locate matching users, with least-privilege data visibility
operations.user_suspend: Admin-only, reason required, 1-2160 hours, immediately invalidate existing sessions
operations.user_role_change: Superadmin-only, protected owner accounts and self-role escalation forbidden
operations.post_hide: Moderator+, reason required, reversible and audit-tracked
operations.report_review: Human reviewer decides; a report is not proof
operations.jobs_manual_run: Admin+ with prompt to confirm, logged
operations.audit_history: Staff-readable, API append-only, not cryptographically immutable

implemented_in_github.daily_expiry_cleanup: Remove expired sessions, OAuth state, over-45-day AI usage counters, expired suspensions
implemented_in_github.community_triage: Queue social posts with >=3 pending reports for human review, never automatically delete
implemented_in_github.idempotency: One scheduled execution per date/automation name
implemented_in_github.frequency: Daily at 03:00 UTC with Cloudflare Cron Trigger

planned_for_both.assignments: Opt-in personalized due-date reminders, timezone-aware delivery and throttling
planned_for_both.ai_costs: Daily quotas, circuit breakers and provider error alerts
planned_for_both.resources: Duplicate detection and copyrighted-content flagging, with staff review
planned_for_both.notifications: Notification preference center, digest batching, cancellation and unsubscribe
planned_for_both.opportunities: Deadline expiry, verified-link checks and eligibility-change review
planned_for_both.security: Anomaly detection, secret rotation runbooks, session-risk checks and audit export
planned_for_both.engagement: Gentle learning follow-ups driven by user-set goals, no manipulative streak-pressure
planned_for_both.analytics: Opt-in aggregated progress metrics, 7/30-day retention cohorts, funnel and incident logs
planned_for_both.workflows: Task queue with retry, dead-letter handling, approval before high-impact actions

security_non_negotiables: Server authorization on every action, never frontend-only guards
Do not expose admin secrets or DB credentials in client bundles
Separate Floot and GitHub account identities until an explicit migration
Human approval before banning, deleting posts, money movement or verifying official accounts
Honor private-account visibility and blocked users in all read surfaces
Record actor, action, target, reason and timestamp for privileged mutations
Protect owner account from delegation and destructive self-actions
Keep maintenance rollback endpoints available to authorized admins
parity_release_gate: Both platforms pass authorization and staff-role tests
Both show the same six feature flags and enforce them at API boundaries
Both record an audit event on privileged mutations
Both safely triage three or more reports without automatic deletion
Both support suspension expiry and manual reversal
Both support emergency read-only mode and admin rollback
Browser and signed-in media tests pass on both implementations
Database migrations and restore procedures are documented
Real Google and Microsoft sign-in tested on both
Public launch only after production smoke tests and permission review
